articles.title: Euro 1998 Ferrari F355 Berlinetta 6-Speed Conversion
articles.description: This 1998 Ferrari F355 Berlinetta is a European-market example that was reportedly initially delivered in Denmark, imported to the US in 2024, and underwent engine-out service before the selling dealer's 2026 acquisition and conversion of the six-speed transaxle to manual operation. The car is powered by a 3.5-liter DOHC V8 and has been further modified with the installation of 18" Speedline wheels, Öhlins suspension, higher-capacity radiators, Fabspeed intake pipes, an F50 steering wheel, a padded roll bar, and OMP harnesses. Finished in Nurburgring Silver over black leather and suede, the car also has a limited-slip differential, Scuderia Ferrari fender shields, a Challenge-style rear grille, carbon-fiber seats, automatic climate control, a cassette stereo, and a gated shifter. Now showing 116k kilometers (~72k miles), this F355 Berlinetta is offered in California with a car cover, a damage-free Carfax report, and a clean Montana title.
